name: onlyoffice-odoo-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end tests for the ONLYOFFICE Odoo connector against a live Document Server

scripts.setup: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.e2e: npm run stack:up && npm test && npm run stack:down
scripts.stack:up: docker compose up -d db documentserver && docker compose run --build --rm web odoo -d e2e -i onlyoffice_odoo --stop-after-init --without-demo=all && docker compose up -d web && node scripts/wait-for-stack.mjs
